news.title: Rubicon Research Limited (NSEI:RUBICON) agreed to acquire 85% stake in arinna Lifesciences Pvt. Ltd. for INR 1.8 billion.
news.body:
Rubicon Research Limited (NSEI:RUBICON) agreed to acquire 85% stake in arinna Lifesciences Pvt. Ltd. for INR 1.8 billion on April 15, 2026. A cash consideration of INR 1.76 billion will be paid by Rubicon Research Limited. Upon acquisition, Arinna will become a subsidiary of the Company.
 The acquisition is expected to be completed within one month from the date of the signing of the transaction documents or by such other timelines as may be mutually agreed between the parties. The final consideration remains subject to adjustments on the closing date.

news.title: Third quarter 2026 earnings: EPS and revenues exceed analyst expectations
news.body: Third quarter 2026 results: EPS: ₹4.46. Net income: ₹728.0m (up ₹728.0m from 3Q 2025). Revenue exceeded analyst estimates by 3.6%. Earnings per share (EPS) also surpassed analyst estimates by 16%. Revenue is forecast to grow 27% p.a. on average during the next 3 years, compared to a 10% growth forecast for the Pharmaceuticals industry in India.

news.title: Rubicon Research Limited Appoints Avani Harish Shah as Senior Management Personnel, Effective January 9, 2026
news.body: Rubicon Research Limited announced the appointment of Ms. Avani Harish Shah as Senior Management Personnel of the Company with effect from January 09, 2026. Avani is a legal professional with 20+ years of corporate legal experience in information technology and services industry. Her previous employment was with LTIMindtree Limited as a Senior Legal Director. Her prior assignments include Associate Director at Ramco Systems Limited, Assistant General Counsel at Capgemini Technologies SE (Paris & India) and managerial positions at Essar Group and Oracle Financial Services Software. She began her legal career as an Associate at Gordhandas and Fozdar (Advocates and Solicitors).
